reply.text: {"say":"Hips and ankles get the work this session: four mobility movements to open them up, all from the mobility library, no cardio and no lifting.","title":"Hip & Ankle Mobility","days":[{"name":"Hip & Ankle Mobility","exercises":[{"key":"90-90-hip-stretch*","sets":2,"reps":0,"repsTo":0,"seconds":45,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Sit tall and rotate slowly through both sides."},{"key":"half-kneeling-hip-flexor-stretch*","sets":2,"reps":0,"repsTo":0,"seconds":40,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze the back glute and keep the torso upright."},{"key":"ankle-dorsiflexion-mobilization","sets":2,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive the knee forward over the toes without the heel lifting."},{"key":"cossack-mobility-drill","sets":2,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Shift side to side and keep the weight low."}]}],"unmet":[]}
